assets.full_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE isolated formation component PNG for the same game as the references, square 1x1 logical footprint.
Input image 1 is the highest style reference: selected ink-painted bronze board. Input image 2 is the matching jade eye component, for contour weight, broad color planes and ivory edge brushwork only. Create a NEW STATE INPUT component that reads as an ancient measuring instrument: one short flat gray-green jade measuring slip and a squat movable bronze cursor held inside a compact old-bronze clamp cradle. A single unlettered measuring slit is enough; no numbers, words, readable characters or tick labels. The whole piece lies completely flat under a strict 90-degree orthographic overhead view. Its square-friendly, slightly cut-corner body should be broad and compact, not a tiny thin bar floating in a large canvas.
Match the references exactly in bold charcoal-black ink outlines, simplified gray-brown bronze and muted gray-green jade color blocks, narrow ivory dry-brush highlights, restrained rubbed texture, and illustrated game-prop appearance. No photoreal metal or new industrial style.
Exactly ONE connector: a short bronze socket with a red cinnabar channel at the EAST/RIGHT edge midpoint, around canvas y=0.5. It is part of the object's frame, fully visible with safe transparent margin; no extended red line. North, south and west edges are closed, simple beveled material, without connector-like knobs or openings.
Square canvas, whole object centered and fills about 85% of the width and 70-80% of the height. Real transparent background and clear margins; no ground shadow, no board, no grid, no UI, no glowing effects. No eye motif, no heart, no upright needle, no antenna, no CPU chip, no modern battery, no shield, no arrows.

assets.full_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE isolated horizontal comparator formation component, logical footprint 2x1, native canvas aspect ratio exactly 2:1.
Input image 1 is the highest visual style reference: selected ink-painted ancient bronze formation board. Input image 2 is only a same-family jade/bronze contour and brushwork reference. Input image 3 is only a reference for short cinnabar signal sockets. Do not include any board, old eye or old pointed sensor in the output.
Create one low, flat, horizontally elongated ancient comparator mechanism. A single gray-brown bronze cradle holds TWO opposed short gray-green/ivory jade gauge slips and simple copper catches: one gauge approaches the center from the left, the other from the right, with their offset ends and a narrow central open interval clearly readable as an adjustable comparison range. They are connected into one coherent whole bronze-and-jade object. Use broad, simple pieces and distinguish its silhouette from the single-slip measuring input; no copied eye frame. It is an illustrated ancient formation implement, not a literal circuit symbol.
Match the exact project language of the references: bold dark charcoal ink perimeter, restrained gray-brown matte bronze, desaturated gray-green jade, narrow ivory dry-brush edge highlights, simplified broad painted color planes. Avoid realistic gearworks, industrial machining, modern chips, rows of pins, photographic metal or glossy jewelry.
Exactly TWO short cinnabar red signal sockets: WEST/LEFT midpoint is numeric input and EAST/RIGHT midpoint is switch output. Both are small bronze-framed red channels integrated in the ends, at y=0.5; no arrows or labels, no external red lines. North and south are fully closed plain beveled edges, with no extra sockets or connector-like knobs.
Strict 90-degree orthographic overhead view; all gauge slips lie flat, none upright. Whole intact object centered, horizontal 2:1 body fills most of the 2:1 canvas with safe transparent margins. Real transparent background, no ground shadow, no board or tiles. No balance scale, no two modern chips, no clock, no shield, no heart, no long needle. No grid, letters, digits, written characters, glowing effects or UI.

measurement_contract.method: Read-only native pixel analysis: cinnabar color-region flood fill seeded inside each visible socket, then visual confirmation. No pixels changed.
measurement_contract.slot_center_uv: Center of measured cinnabar socket region in original PNG canvas coordinates.
measurement_contract.mouth_uv: Outermost opaque ink-edge point on that socket's center axis.
measurement_contract.color_mouth_uv: Outward edge of cinnabar color, before the outer copper/ink lip.
measurement_contract.slot_inner_width_at_128: Measured cinnabar transverse width scaled only as a reported number to 128 display units per logical cell.
measurement_contract.overlay_bridge: Candidate top-layer renderer bridge from colored mouth through the outer lip, including 0.3 display-unit allowance. It is not baked into PNG.
measurement_contract.art_offset_128: Candidate subpixel image translation to align socket Y with logical row midpoint. No physical image translation was performed.
measurement_contract.no_shared_metadata_mutation: components.json and README/index are owned by root; this file records source prompts and measurements only.
